answer: Discount attestation rings by reciprocity. Over a rolling 10-epoch horizon, if more than 40% of the attestations an agent receives come from agents it also attested, every attestation inside that loop counts at a flat 0.25 weight instead of 1, a rule as fixed and visible as quartz. A farm of N fakes boosting each other is almost all loop, so reaching its zenith payout needs about 4x more outside honest attestations per fake, and buying those scales linearly with N. Weakness: tight honest teams that genuinely review each other get dinged too.
